name_zh: 缅甸·昂山：独立将军与女儿民主军事张力
name_en: Myanmar Aung San: Independence General & Daughter Democracy Military Tension
description_zh: 昂山 (1915-1947) 缅甸独立之父，三十同志创始人，二战初期与日军合作后倒向英军，1947年庞隆协议实现少数民族联邦，同年遇刺，女儿昂山素季继承民主事业与军政府博弈三十年。
description_en: Aung San (1915-1947) Myanmar independence father, Thirty Comrades founder, initially cooperated with Japanese then switched to British, 1947 Panglong Agreement achieved ethnic federalism, assassinated same year, daughter Aung San Suu Kyi inherited democracy cause wrestling with military junta for thirty years.
reason_zh: 昂山代表缅甸独立与联邦建构的双重未竟事业，展示了少数民族联邦制如何在军人政治、意识形态分裂、外部干预中反复破裂，父女两代悲剧折射缅甸国家建构核心困境。
reason_en: Aung San represents Myanmar independence and federal construction dual unfinished business, demonstrating how ethnic federalism fractures repeatedly amid military politics, ideological division, external intervention, father-daughter dual tragedy reflecting Myanmar state-building core dilemma.
steps_zh: 研究昂山早年学生领袖与三十同志日本军官训练
分析1945年反法西斯人民自由同盟倒向英军
探讨1947年庞隆协议少数民族联邦构想与遇刺
评估昂山素季继承遗产与1988/2021军政府对抗
总结父女两代独立将军女儿民主军事张力的历史宿命
steps_en: Study Aung San early student leader and Thirty Comrades Japanese officer training
Analyze 1945 Anti-Fascist Peoples Freedom League switch to British
Explore 1947 Panglong Agreement ethnic federalism vision and assassination
Evaluate Aung San Suu Kyi inheritance and 1988/2021 military junta confrontation
Summarize father-daughter independence general daughter democracy military tension historical destiny
expected_zh: 理解缅甸少数民族联邦制为何在军人政治中反复破裂，掌握独立领袖遗产如何在女儿身上转化为民主符号与军政府攻击靶子，评估缅甸联邦民主化的根本障碍。
expected_en: Understand why Myanmar ethnic federalism repeatedly fractures under military politics, grasp how independence leader legacy transforms into democracy symbol and military junta target on daughter, evaluate Myanmar federal democratization fundamental obstacles.
case_zh: 1941 三十同志；1945 倒向英军；1947 庞隆协议/遇刺；1988 素季领导起义；2021 政变入狱。独立将军女儿民主军事范式永存。
case_en: 1941 Thirty Comrades; 1945 switched to British; 1947 Panglong/assassination; 1988 Suu Kyi led uprising; 2021 coup imprisoned. Independence general daughter democracy military paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Independence father; federalism vision; daughter democracy icon; military junta tension
